\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 232-235 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R240-first-pass-words-from-chapters-232-235}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to here and a side.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to soak, to dip, to sink, to flow, to unfold
  \item the ankle, blood, breath, diarrhoea, an allergy
  \item enthusiasm, disappointment, self-confidence, excitement, relief
  \item a wrist, a heel, the spine, the liver, a kidney
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To soak? (\textbf{\ml{കുതിർക്കുക}}, \emph{kutirkkuka}.) To dip? (\textbf{\ml{മുക്കുക}}, \emph{mukkuka}.) To sink? (\textbf{\ml{മുങ്ങുക}}, \emph{muṅṅuka}.) To flow? (\textbf{\ml{ഒഴുകുക}}, \emph{oḻukuka}.) To unfold? (\textbf{\ml{നിവർത്തുക}}, \emph{nivarttuka}.) The ankle? (\textbf{\ml{കണങ്കാൽ}}, \emph{kaṇaṅkāl}.) Blood? (\textbf{\ml{ചോര}}, \emph{cōra}.) Breath? (\textbf{\ml{ശ്വാസം}}, \emph{śvāsaṁ}.) Diarrhoea? (\textbf{\ml{വയറിളക്കം}}, \emph{vayaṟiḷakkaṁ}.) An allergy? (\textbf{\ml{അലർജി}}, \emph{alarji}.) Enthusiasm? (\textbf{\ml{ഉത്സാഹം}}, \emph{utsāhaṁ}.) Disappointment? (\textbf{\ml{നിരാശ}}, \emph{nirāśa}.) Self-confidence? (\textbf{\ml{ആത്മവിശ്വാസം}}, \emph{ātmaviśvāsaṁ}.) Excitement? (\textbf{\ml{ആവേശം}}, \emph{āvēśaṁ}.) Relief? (\textbf{\ml{ആശ്വാസം}}, \emph{āśvāsaṁ}.) A wrist? (\textbf{\ml{കണങ്കൈ}}, \emph{kaṇaṅkai}.) A heel? (\textbf{\ml{ഉപ്പൂറ്റി}}, \emph{uppūṟṟi}.) The spine? (\textbf{\ml{നട്ടെല്ല്}}, \emph{naṭṭellŭ}.) The liver? (\textbf{\ml{കരൾ}}, \emph{karaḷ}.) A kidney? (\textbf{\ml{വൃക്ക}}, \emph{vṛkka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 236-240 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R240-second-pass-words-from-chapters-236-240}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for childhood and Atham.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item childhood, Atham, Thiruvonam, dusk, a moment
  \item daytime, someday, the day before, the following day, the day before yesterday
  \item in the middle, an airport, the railway, a passenger, a junction
  \item a corner, a hill, the backwaters, a stream, a cave
  \item the end, across, to there, to here, a side
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Childhood? (\textbf{\ml{കുട്ടിക്കാലം}}, \emph{kuṭṭikkālaṁ}.) Atham? (\textbf{\ml{അത്തം}}, \emph{attaṁ}.) Thiruvonam? (\textbf{\ml{തിരുവോണം}}, \emph{tiruvōṇaṁ}.) Dusk? (\textbf{\ml{സന്ധ്യ}}, \emph{sandhya}.) A moment? (\textbf{\ml{നിമിഷം}}, \emph{nimiṣaṁ}.) Daytime? (\textbf{\ml{പകൽ}}, \emph{pakal}.) Someday? (\textbf{\ml{എന്നെങ്കിലും}}, \emph{enneṅkiluṁ}.) The day before? (\textbf{\ml{തലേന്ന്}}, \emph{talēnnŭ}.) The following day? (\textbf{\ml{പിറ്റേന്ന്}}, \emph{piṟṟēnnŭ}.) The day before yesterday? (\textbf{\ml{മിനിഞ്ഞാന്ന്}}, \emph{miniññānnŭ}.) In the middle? (\textbf{\ml{നടുവിൽ}}, \emph{naṭuvil}.) An airport? (\textbf{\ml{വിമാനത്താവളം}}, \emph{vimānattāvaḷaṁ}.) The railway? (\textbf{\ml{റെയിൽവേ}}, \emph{ṟeyilvē}.) A passenger? (\textbf{\ml{യാത്രക്കാരൻ}}, \emph{yātrakkāran}.) A junction? (\textbf{\ml{കവല}}, \emph{kavala}.) A corner? (\textbf{\ml{മൂല}}, \emph{mūla}.) A hill? (\textbf{\ml{കുന്ന്}}, \emph{kunnŭ}.) The backwaters? (\textbf{\ml{കായൽ}}, \emph{kāyal}.) A stream? (\textbf{\ml{തോട്}}, \emph{tōṭŭ}.) A cave? (\textbf{\ml{ഗുഹ}}, \emph{guha}.) The end? (\textbf{\ml{അറ്റം}}, \emph{aṟṟaṁ}.) Across? (\textbf{\ml{കുറുകെ}}, \emph{kuṟuke}.) To there? (\textbf{\ml{അങ്ങോട്ട്}}, \emph{aṅṅōṭṭŭ}.) To here? (\textbf{\ml{ഇങ്ങോട്ട്}}, \emph{iṅṅōṭṭŭ}.) A side? (\textbf{\ml{വശം}}, \emph{vaśaṁ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
